problem_statement: The DFU image manager picks the wrong partition as the upload (update) partition. The running application partition is the one named by the zephyr,code-partition chosen node in the device tree (the slot that is currently executing the firmware), and the upload partition must be the other slot. When the running partition is the first slot (slot0), the detection mis-evaluated which slot is the running one, so the default upload partition resolved to the running slot itself instead of the other slot. As a result, a flash image context created with the default upload partition (flash_img_init) ended up pointing at the wrong flash area, and the partition the image manager treats as the upload slot did not match the non-running slot.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/subsys/dfu/img_util -s tests/subsys/dfu/img_util/dfu.image_util -s dfu.image_util -O twister-out --no-clean -W
